exposure: Type of substance use (polysubstance use vs. single substance use)
Combinations of mental health comorbidities (depression, anxiety, posttraumatic stress disorder)
outcome: Continued substance use during pregnancy (use in the 30 days prior to delivery)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 281 pregnant women enrolled in a comprehensive prenatal program for substance use disorders.
finding: Substance use at admission and the number of mental health conditions were independent predictors of continued substance use during pregnancy, with substance use being the stronger predictor.
